```yaml
name: Bump OpenInference Instrumentation Version

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*.*.*'

jobs:
  bump-version:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
          cache: 'pip'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install setuptools wheel twine

      - name: Find and update version numbers
        run: |
          find . -type f -name '*.py' -exec sed -i '' 's/"openinference-instrumentation": ".*"/"openinference-instrumentation": ">=0.1.28"/g' {} +
          find . -type f -name '*.py' -exec sed -i '' 's/"openinference-semantic-conventions": ".*"/"openinference-semantic-conventions": ">=0.1.28"/g' {} +

      - name: Create pull request
        id: create_pr
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: bump openinference-instrumentation and openinference-semantic-conventions"
          title: "Bump openinference-instrumentation and openinference-semantic-conventions"
          body: "This PR bumps the minimum version of `openinference-instrumentation` and `openinference-semantic-conventions` across all Python instrumentor packages."
          base: main
          head: bump-version
```

This GitHub Actions workflow will trigger when a new tag is pushed to the repository, indicating a new release. It sets up Python, installs necessary dependencies, finds and updates the version numbers in the Python files, and creates a pull request with the changes. The pull request will be based on the `main` branch and will target the `bump-version` branch.
